name: Ch’üan Te-yü
bio: Ch’üan Te-yü (AD 759–818) was a T’ang official and poet. His poem here is a brief verse addressed to a bride.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: Hope
poems.author: Ch’üan Te-yü
poems.text:
Last eve thou wert a bride,
This morn thy dream is o'er
Cast not thy rouge aside,
He may be thine once more.
